product.title: Matematica. Teste pentru evaluarea nationala. Clasa a IV-a
product.description: Dragul nostru elev, Știm că ai muncit mult în clasa a IV-a și că ai învățat multe lucruri. Îți propunem să dovedești ce ai învățat rezolvând testele din acest caiet. Vei avea de rezolvat exerciții și probleme diverse, unele în care vei alege varianta corectă din patru variante date, altele în care vei rezolva efectiv, vei aprecia dacă anumite enunțuri sunt adevărate sau false, vei căuta informații în tabele și le vei folosi în rezolvare etc. În unele exerciții va trebui să formulezi păreri personale și să le argumentezi. Indiferent de exercițiu sau problemă, cunoștințele de care ai nevoie pentru rezolvare sunt cele predate și învățate de tine în clasă. Nu-ți rămâne decât să citești cu mare grijă cerința, de mai multe ori, dacă e cazul, până ești sigur că ai înțeles corect ce ți se cere. Apoi, mai ai nevoie de atenție la calcule și la formularea răspunsurilor. Îți urăm succes și sperăm că acest caiet îți va fi util în pregătirea pentru Evaluarea Națională de la sfârșitul clasei a IV-a! Autoarele   Aprobat de MEN prin ordinul 5318/2019.

# Mathematics Test Book for National Evaluation â Grade 4 (Clasa a IV-a)

Prepare your student for success with this comprehensive **Mathematics Test Book**, designed specifically for students completing the 4th grade. Published by Litera, this resource is an essential tool for reinforcing core mathematical concepts and ensuring readiness for the crucial National Evaluation exam.

Whether your child needs practice with foundational arithmetic or wants to build confidence before standardized testing, this book offers a structured review of all the material taught throughout the academic year. It helps students transition from classroom learning to complex assessment scenarios.

***

## Comprehensive Coverage for Grade 4 Mathematics

This resource is more than just a collection of problems; it simulates the diverse format and rigor of the actual National Evaluation. The content ensures that students develop not only mathematical ability but also crucial critical thinking skills needed to tackle unexpected exam questions.

**What does this book cover?**
The exercises are designed to replicate various question types found in national assessments, ensuring holistic preparation:

*   **Multiple Choice Questions:** Practice selecting the correct answer from four given options.
*   **Open-Ended Problem Solving:** Requires active calculation and detailed solutions.
*   **Critical Thinking & Analysis:** Includes determining if statements are true or false (AdevÄrate/False).
*   **Data Interpretation:** Teaches students how to extract, analyze, and utilize information presented in various tables and graphs for problem solving.
*   **Argumentation Skills:** Some exercises require forming personal opinions and supporting them with logical arguments, connecting math skills with broader reasoning.

All problems and concepts included are based on the curriculum taught and mastered by students in Grade 4.

## Key Features & Benefits

*   **Structured Preparation:** Offers a systematic review of all mathematical topics covered up to the end of Grade 4.
*   **Builds Confidence:** By practicing varied question types, students approach the actual evaluation with greater confidence and familiarity.
*   **Authoritative Content:** The material is approved by MEN (Ministry of National Education) under Order 5318/2019, ensuring curricular relevance.
*   **Boosts Focus:** Encourages careful reading of instructions and attention to detailâskills crucial for any high-stakes exam.

***

### Need Help Preparing for the Exam?

If you are looking for reliable **Grade 4 math tests** or preparatory materials that mimic a real national evaluation, this book provides the comprehensive practice needed. Students will find the detailed format helpful in mastering both calculation speed and analytical problem-solving methods.

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book suitable for all math levels?**
A: The content is specifically designed to cover the breadth of knowledge taught in Grade 4, making it highly useful for students who need a comprehensive review leading up to their National Evaluation.

**Q: Does the book provide answers or solutions?**
A: While the description emphasizes practice and understanding the required skills (such as analyzing tables and forming arguments), this is a preparatory workbook designed for active student resolution of problems.
